text:
Ira: heads-up — customer 'nova' started gzipping embedding payloads and hit a bunch of 413s from preflight this AM. preflight uses post-compress bytes so framing failed.
Maya: can you paste sample?
Ira: curl they ran + runtime log: `preflight: compressed=true but declared_frames=0 -> invalid (413)`. they zipped an array of vectors.
Dev: we always rejected compressed bodies historically to keep billing deterministic (vector-units). decompressing shifts CPU costs and billing semantics.
Ravi: product side: customers expect vector-unit billing. but some enterprise partners want to send compressed traffic to save net egress. we need a safe contract.
Maya: proposal: optional `X-Embed-Client-Meta: encoding=gzip;vectors=200;avg_len=1024` header. runtime validates and chooses per-tenant policy: REJECT | DECOMPRESS_AND_BILL_UNCOMPRESSED | ACCEPT_COMPRESSED_BILL_BYTES.
Ira: for ACCEPT_COMPRESSED we require tenant opt-in and console visibility: show compressed_bytes, decompressed_estimated_units, billed_method.
Dev: routing note — if we decompress at edge we must preserve affinity for later cache hits. add `X-Affinity-Key` so dispatcher can pin short TTL.
Ravi: billing: prefer reported vectors in header if HMAC-signed by tenant key; otherwise if decompress enabled compute units; else bill by bytes with agreed conversion.
ingest-bot: alert tenant=nova embed_reject_rate=7% window=10m threshold=2%
Maya: action items: API header RFC (Dev), runtime toggle + affinity (Ira), billing mapping and sig scheme (Ravi), console telemetry card for canary (Maya). start opt-in beta for partners. :thumbsup:
